name: The Best Taste of Asia
reviews: One of the best Asian restaurants in Kingsford! Every dish we ordered was delicious, with generous portions and great value for money. The crispy oat prawns were perfectly crispy on the outside and juicy on the inside. The staff were warm, professional, and provided outstanding service. A fantastic place for family dinners or meals with friends. Highly recommended!
风味茄子分量很大但是酸甜口有点太酸甜了，我印象里风味茄子可能还得再偏咸一点？牛肉粉丝煲给的牛肉分量始终，总的来说味道不错也不会踩雷！

As a first timer at this restaurant, we were not disappointed. The service was friendly, quick & efficient with a good selection of generous dishes, relaxed & busy. My friend & I ordered the Mixed Dimsum, Chicken with Fried Rice & Eggplant. The Eggplant was the best & absolutely delish that I have had so far, either locally or overseas; the Chicken & Friend Rice was tasteful & plentiful. We were not impressed with the Mixed Dimsum, as the wrapper was a bit thick, chewy, bland & undercooked. I would have given a 5*, except for this, but this will not stop me from coming back to try the other dishes.
Tried this restaurant, Sydney was still a bit cold so we need to eat hearty meal. The menu we ordered did not dissapoint, we also got big portion of rice.

Went here for a quick lunch date. Their dish portion was really generous! Unfortunately, the dishes we've ordered is only so-so. The duck was juicy & yummy, but the noodle lack flavour. The pork belly udon soup also a bit lack in flavour and the udon vs meat ratio is not good (too much noodle). To make it worse, there is a guy sit next to us that chew and slurp so loud! We might come back again to try their other dishes & hope that other guy wasnt there 😅
